nodes.description: Public address state variable 'dead' initialized to address(0); never read or written after deployment.
Owner address state variable; set to msg.sender in the constructor and later overwritten by transferOwnership.
IERC20 token reference stored in the constructor from the untrusted _dpr constructor argument.
Constructor: casts _dpr to IERC20 into 'dpr' and sets 'owner' to msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
External onlyOwner function that calls dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount), moving tokens out of the contract.
External onlyOwner function that calls dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount), moving tokens out of the contract.
External onlyOwner function that overwrites the owner state variable with _newOwner.
Caller-controlled address used for the constructor ownership assignment and the onlyOwner authorization check.
External low-level token call dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) inside to_dead; executes an untrusted contract call without a reentrancy guard.
External low-level token call dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) inside withdraw; executes an untrusted contract call without a reentrancy guard.
Privileged state write 'owner = _newOwner' that transfers full control of the contract to an arbitrary address.
Constructor parameter _dpr, the token address cast to IERC20 and stored in dpr.
Parameter _amount of to_dead, forwarded as the transfer value to safeTransfer.
Parameter _amount of withdraw, forwarded as the transfer value to safeTransfer.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, written into the owner state variable.

edges.reason: Constructor converts the _dpr parameter and stores it into the dpr state variable.
Constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads msg.sender to authorize the caller against owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable in its require(msg.sender == owner) check.
onlyOwner gates execution of to_dead.
onlyOwner gates execution of withdraw.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
to_dead body executes the dpr.safeTransfer operation.
withdraw body executes the dpr.safeTransfer operation.
transferOwnership body performs the owner reassignment operation.
to_dead forwards its _amount parameter as the value of safeTransfer.
withdraw forwards its _amount parameter as the value of safeTransfer.
The dpr state variable is the token target of the safeTransfer call in to_dead.
The dpr state variable is the token target of the safeTransfer call in withdraw.
owner is used as the recipient argument of safeTransfer in to_dead.
owner is used as the recipient argument of safeTransfer in withdraw.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner parameter into privileged ownership state.
The reassignment operation updates the owner state variable, changing the authorization subject.
The untrusted token call in to_dead can re-enter withdraw before state settles.
The untrusted token call in to_dead can recursively re-enter to_dead itself.
The untrusted token call in withdraw can re-enter to_dead before state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _dpr is only used to initialize the dpr state variable inside the constructor, so it can be normalized into the constructor node.
The parameter _amount of to_dead has no independent behavior and only feeds the safeTransfer operation, so it merges into to_dead.
The parameter _amount of withdraw has no independent behavior and only feeds the safeTransfer operation, so it merges into withdraw.
The parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership exists solely to update the owner state variable and merges into transferOwnership.
